svg.desc: Overview of Shield, private tabs, dark websites, built-in player, downloader and customisation.
svg.text: Everything you need in one glass-clear browser. No account, no server of its own.
Real Adblock-Plus rules, host lists, a behaviour-based popup guard
and cosmetic hiding, all running on your phone.
Any site, even in light mode.
2K / 4K offered only if your phone can decode it.
yt-dlp + FFmpeg built in. Split into parts,
downloaded over many connections at once.
